title: 🍕 FT - Items : Issue with StockQty calculation at ItemDetail and Txn Screen
description:
DB shared for Item 1 (id =6)
expected 16.8 

SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN OD.txnType IN (2, 20, 21) THEN OI.quantity  -- Add to stock
            WHEN OD.txnType IN (1, 22) THEN -OI.quantity     -- Subtract from stock
            ELSE 0                                           -- Ignore others
        END
    ) AS currentStockQty
FROM 
    OrderItems OI
LEFT JOIN 
    SubOrderDetails SOD ON SOD.id = OI.subOrderId
LEFT JOIN 
    OrderDetails OD ON OD.id = SOD.orderId
WHERE 
    OI.itemId = 6;
